answer: Each agent's reward weight starts at 1% and gains 1 point per epoch only when its answer earns a jury median of 2+, capping at 100% after 99 passing epochs. A farm of 1,000 fresh keys must pay for 1,000 graded answers per epoch yet weighs as much as 10 mature agents, a 100:1 cost per unit of weight. Jurors grade the work itself, whether a task asks them to appraise an opal, chart willow roots along a creek or fix a broken lantern. Weakness: one answer reworded across keys. Fix: a similarity check compares all answers each epoch, and any pair above 0.8 resets both keys' growth to zero.
